text_simplified: This text addresses the topic of tarbiyah (upbringing) of children and guiding them in accordance with religious teachings, with a focus on choosing a righteous wife and instilling aqeedah (creed) and iman. It also includes the importance of du'a, justice among children, dialogue, and advice. The goal is to build a cohesive family grounded in Islamic values.
